steps.label: with-no-gap-anywhere-in-it
steps.script: (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/stems/Calin%20-%20Stovky%20let/beats')).json();const b=d.beats,beat=60/d.bpm;for(let i=1;i<b.length;i++) if(b[i]-b[i-1]>beat*1.6) return 'gap at '+b[i-1];return true})()

steps.label: and-the-lane-draws-clicks-in-the-silent-intro
steps.script: (()=>{const cv=document.querySelector('.metro-canvas');if(!cv)return 'no canvas';const g=cv.getContext('2d');const w=Math.floor(cv.width*0.12);const d=g.getImageData(0,0,w,cv.height).data;let lit=0;for(let i=3;i<d.length;i+=4) if(d[i]>10) lit++;return lit>200?true:'only '+lit})()
